Package implementations

Class MyDLL

java.lang.Object
implementations.MyDLL
All Implemented Interfaces:
ListADT
public class MyDLL extends Object implements ListADT
A doubly linked list (DLL) implementation of the ListADT interface, for use in CPRG 304 at SAIT.

This class stores String elements in a chain of MyDLLNode objects, each of which holds a reference to both its predecessor (pred) and its successor (succ). The list maintains explicit head and tail references for O(1) access to both ends of the chain. Insertions and removals at arbitrary positions require O(n) traversal. All index parameters are zero-based unless otherwise noted.

Design Note – String-Specific Implementation:
This class is intentionally designed to store String elements only. A fully reusable, type-safe design would use Java generics (e.g., MyDLL<E>), allowing any object type to be stored in the list. Generic programming is outside the scope of CPRG 304 and has therefore been omitted. All element fields, parameters, and return types are fixed as String throughout this class and its implementations.
